data.body: Minimal ancestor gate milestone: delivery container dendritic-irksome-raven passed plan review with a durable current certificate at 32d0df68501f; then and only then started the epic rubbery-glacial-cowbird review. No unrelated leaf reviews were started. Independent non-author before-state review for goldfilled-portly-dungbeetle inventoried 15 bloated blocks (E1-E15) and 10 concise/load-bearing blocks to preserve unchanged across infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf and infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template. It cross-checked the nginx structural tests, materializers, autodeploy, runbook, and auth/setup docs; no source or tracker mutation was made by the reviewer.
